items.title: Clarify current implementation baseline and source mapping
items.context: Fix audit findings that existing scope/owner/parallel/baseline surfaces are described as future work. Add a current-status axis and Authority receipt/lifecycle receipt source documents so implementers do not duplicate existing gates.

happy.desc: The roadmap states the current implementation baseline for scope, owner, parallel work, and baseline surfaces, marking what is already implemented versus future work.

edge.desc: Each baseline surface is mapped to its source of truth, including Authority receipt, lifecycle receipt consumption, lifecycle artifact scope, story lifecycle, session ownership, and parallel wave documents where applicable.

adversarial.desc: The repaired docs must not describe existing scope, owner, parallel, baseline, Authority receipt, or lifecycle receipt behavior as merely planned future work.

items.userSees: 用户看到："CHK-001 done: roadmap now lists current implementation status and Authority/lifecycle receipt source mapping; existing scope/owner/parallel/baseline surfaces are not described as net-new future work."

items.title: Make review escalation and validation requirements mechanical
items.context: Fix audit findings around ambiguous 3x2 predicate, local verdict signature/verifiability wording, and prose-only validation. Add minimal command sets and expected artifact/row ids for the relevant roadmap milestones.

happy.desc: The related roadmap documents define the three-round by two-host escalation predicate mechanically, with named inputs, decision table or equivalent truth conditions, outputs, and the exact escalation/no-escalation result.

edge.desc: Local verdict signature and verifiability requirements are documented with signer, signed fields, freshness/hash expectations, and invalid/stale signature handling.

adversarial.desc: Validation cannot remain prose-only: each relevant milestone lists minimal validation commands plus expected artifacts, artifact ids, or roadmap row ids that evidence the 3x2 predicate and verdict signature behavior.

items.userSees: 用户看到："CHK-002 done: roadmap now defines the requires3x2 predicate, counted host verdict binding/signature requirements, and concrete validation commands/artifacts for M0/M6/M8/M12."

items.title: Specify rollout crosswalk and recovery controls
items.context: Fix audit findings around rollout policy/version binding, in-flight story treatment, false-positive rollback/de-escalation, M11 staging before blockers, milestone-to-rollout crosswalk, and self-hosting emergency bypass.

happy.desc: The roadmap contains a milestone-to-rollout crosswalk that binds each affected milestone to rollout stage, policy version, enforcement mode, and expected operator-visible artifact or command evidence.

edge.desc: In-flight story treatment, false-positive rollback or de-escalation, and recovery controls are documented for stories already past PLAN/DEV/REVIEW when the rollout policy changes.

adversarial.desc: The self-hosting emergency bypass is tightly scoped, auditable, time-bounded or version-bounded, and cannot silently bypass policy/version gates or permanent blocker semantics.

items.userSees: 用户看到 roadmap 文档包含 milestone-to-rollout crosswalk、rollout policy/version 绑定、in-flight story treatment、false-positive rollback/de-escalation、M11 staged runbook prerequisite，以及自托管 gate over-block 的审计化 emergency bypass。
